question: Does the frozen crypto-trend-core design (DON8 + EMA8, entry inverse-vol sizing, v3.1 with funding, 20 bps) earn positive net returns on liquid crypto perps that no repository protocol has evaluated, over their full history to the freeze?
registration_note: Registered 2026-09-27 before any strategy result on these coins was computed. Selection used only MEXC contract metadata and 24h turnover. Some coins' prices (no strategy results) appeared in the 2026-09-26 effective-bets correlation study.
evaluation_rule: run exactly once from a commit containing this file

selection_rule.pool: top 100 MEXC USDT perps by 24h turnover on 2026-09-27
selection_rule.exclude_zones: tradfi, stock, stockindex, Forex, Commodities, metals
selection_rule.exclude_used: the 17 crypto-trend-core coins and any symbol referenced by another repository protocol

survivorship_caveat: selecting by current turnover favours surviving, popular coins; delisted coins are unavailable from MEXC. Per-coin breadth is reported so this bias can be judged.

economics.funding: Binance USDT-M history (symbol or 1000-prefixed) where available, otherwise MEXC history (from 2025-04); coverage reported per coin
economics.portfolio: equal capital across sleeves with data that day, rebalanced daily

secondary_descriptive: share of coins with positive total sleeve return
